sloka: अथ सा हरिशार्दूलम् प्रविशन्तिम् महाबलम् ।नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम् ॥५-३-२०॥
transliteration: atha sā hariśārdūlam praviśantim mahābalam ।nagarī svena rūpeṇa dadarśa pavanātmajam ॥5-3-20॥

translations.english: Assuming her real form the presiding deity of Lanka noticed the son of the Windgod, the tiger among vanaras of great prowess entering the city.
